questions: How many NbSe2-terminated resonators did you fabricate and cool down, and how many gave a usable λ/4 resonance?
Why were the others set aside, and why are D10 to D12 absent from Fig. 4a and D6, D7 and D9 to D12 absent from Fig. 4c?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: bath temperatures above 10 mK, powers above −80 dBm, and DC bias beyond the 15 µA in Fig. 3e,f (the text on p. 6 says up to 30 µA)?
What do the power and DC-bias sweeps of Fig. 3 look like for a second device, for example D1, which has the largest Kerr coefficient?

Is each Al-terminated control on the same chip as its NbSe2 resonator, how far does fr,Al spread for identical designs, and how much inductance do the edge contacts and leads add? D10 to D12 shift by only 20 to 30 MHz, and their Lk,sq sits two to three times above μ0λ²/d with your λ ≈ 230 nm (p. 9).

Which sample gives each row of Table S3 (I could not find the 7-layer row in Table S1), how does the Fig. 4c slope change without the literature monolayer point or with D1 at the 1.5 layers Raman gives, and what do the error bars in Fig. 4 represent?

How did you calibrate the photon number in Eq. 5 (line attenuation and Qc), with what uncertainty, and does the power shift of Fig. 3b separate from a bath-temperature shift? How do the rising Qi of Fig. S4c and the linewidth broadening reported on p. 27 fit together? (The lowest tick in Fig. 3c reads −1.15 MHz; from the spacing it looks like −0.15.)
Could you show Lk(I) closer to I* = 0.4 mA, or Lk versus temperature, so the reading of Fig. 3f as anisotropic nodeless pairing can be compared with an isotropic gap?
